title: HydrogenVM Test Lab result
description: Schema version 1. Both per-case and full-run reports use this document.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the report was written.

runId.description: Stable unique identifier for this run (UUID or datetime-hex). Same across all cases in one run.

appVersion.description: CFBundleShortVersionString of the Test Lab guest app.

appBuild.description: CFBundleVersion of the Test Lab guest app.

artifactSha256.description: SHA-256 of the IPA that was imported. null when not measured.

workloadConfig.description: Describes the workload variant that was run (e.g. 'default', 'quick'). null when not applicable.

sandboxMode.description: Sandbox/container mode, e.g. 'hvm-home', 'device-sandbox'. null when unknown.

host.description: Host/runner metadata. All fields optional so guest-side reports can omit them.

emulatorCommit.description: Git commit hash of the emulator that ran this test. null when not available — do not invent.

emulatorDirty.description: True when the emulator working tree had uncommitted changes. null when not measured.

startTime.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the first case started.

version.description: Case implementation version. Increment when expected output changes.

status.description: passed = assertion held; failed = assertion did not hold; skipped = precondition missing; interrupted = crash/kill detected on relaunch.

expected.description: The value or description the test expected. Type depends on the case.

actual.description: The value or description the test observed. Type depends on the case.

reason.description: Human-readable diagnostic. Required when status is failed, skipped, or interrupted.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock time from case start to end, in milliseconds (monotonic clock).

checkpointWritten.description: True when the in-progress checkpoint was written before the risky section executed.
